description: This Java source file defines the LoraProtocolAdapter class, which is a Vert.x-based HTTP protocol adapter for handling LoRa communication in the Eclipse Hono framework. It manages routes for handling LoRa provider messages, performs authentication, processes incoming messages, and forwards them downstream.

classes.name: LoraProtocolAdapter
classes.description: A Vert.x-based HTTP protocol adapter for handling LoRa messages in the Eclipse Hono framework, supporting route setup, authentication, message processing, and forwarding.

methods.name: setLoraProviders
methods.description: Sets the list of supported LoraProvider instances for this adapter.

methods.name: setUsernamePasswordAuthProvider
methods.description: Configures the authentication provider for device credentials using username and password.

methods.name: setClientCertAuthProvider
methods.description: Configures the authentication provider for device credentials using client certificates.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for this protocol adapter type.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Sets up HTTP routes on the provided router, including authorization and provider-specific routes.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamMessage
methods.description: Adds properties and normalized data to the message before forwarding downstream.

methods.name: setupAuthorization
methods.description: Configures authentication handlers for the router, including TLS and Basic auth.

methods.name: handleProviderRoute
methods.description: Handles incoming provider requests, extracts message type, device ID, payload, and forwards or discards accordingly.

methods.name: getCurrentSpan
methods.description: Retrieves the current tracing span from the routing context.

methods.name: handleOptionsRoute
methods.description: Handles HTTP OPTIONS requests for CORS and provider checks.

methods.name: doUpload
methods.description: Processes and forwards received telemetry payloads to downstream systems, with validation.

methods.name: handle202
methods.description: Responds with HTTP 202 Accepted for messages that are intentionally discarded.

methods.name: handle401
methods.description: Responds with HTTP 401 Unauthorized if authentication fails.

methods.name: handle400
methods.description: Responds with HTTP 400 Bad Request for malformed messages or validation failures.

methods.name: handle200
methods.description: Responds with HTTP 200 OK for successful operations.
